result: Token conditions pass: 0.8375x native [0.733, 0.956] and 0.727x control. Supported answers 79 vs native 73 (+6 [-3,+15]) and control 66 (+13 [+4,+22]). Fails only "no more material errors than either control": split 7, native 1, control 5.
material_error_analysis: 4 of 7 split errors are in uncapped 2-call runs on questions that draw errors from every arm across studies (requote_uri, distribution filenames, collected errors, WSGI). 3 are in the 23 runs cut off at 4 calls (13% material there vs 5% in uncapped runs). Questions where only split erred vs only native: 4:4 and 4:3 in the two uncapped studies, 6:0 here; pooled 14:7 (sign test p~0.19). The cap makes the forced final answer assert unverified details.
limitations: Asymmetric stop policy: answers whether PASR needs fewer calls, not a same-budget comparison.
